# `gh-tmpl check`

- **Usage:** `gh-tmpl check [FLAGS] [kind]`

Check an issue or pull request body against its template.

The kind defaults to pr. Use "--body-file -" to read the body from standard
input. The check reports missing headings, empty sections, template comments
left in the body, and checklists that nobody touched.

Exit codes:

```
0  the body passes, or the repository has no template of this kind
1  the body fails the check
2  bad arguments, or no single template to check against
```

## Arguments
- **`[kind]`** — The template kind: pr (the default) or issue

  **Choices:** `pr`, `issue`

## Flags
- **`-F --body-file <file>`** — Read the body from this file (use - for standard input)
- **`-b --body <text>`** — The body text
- **`--name <template>`** — Check against the template with this ID, file name or name
- **`--template-file <file>`** — Check against this template file instead of discovering one
- **`--strict`** — Fail on warnings too
- **`--allow-unchecked`** — Report an untouched checklist as a warning, not an error
- **`--json`** — Print the report as JSON
- **`-R --repo <repo>`** — Read the templates of [HOST/]OWNER/REPO through the API
- **`--offline`** — Do not read the owner's shared .github repository

## Examples

```
gh tmpl check --body-file body.md
```

```
gh tmpl check issue --name bug_report --body-file body.md --json
```

```
git log -1 --format=%b | gh tmpl check --body-file -
```
